why:
The briefs handle all four must_catch items.
1. Verifier Check 3 runs `node BIN clean1.jsonl missing.jsonl bad1.jsonl` in one command. It requires exit 2, stderr naming missing.jsonl, and "stdout still contains bad1's `:2:` line". This is the combined case, not each case on its own.
2. Verifier Check 4 runs `git diff <base>...HEAD -- packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js` and passes only if the diff is empty.
3. Builder step 4 says "Update packages/jsonl-lint/README.md", covering multi-file usage, `-` for stdin and the exit codes.
4. Verifier Check 6 reads GitHub with `gh pr view ... --json body,headRefOid` and `gh pr checks`. It requires the body to contain "Closes https://github.com/suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test/issues/104" and "The `test` workflow check at the head SHA has succeeded."
